full_details: The moon was full. Titus played at the Cross Keys at two, and you were at the lodging. In the late morning you copied slowly and put a cross by a line you do not trust. You could not sleep for coughing. Near ten you went down to the door in your cloak, walked the close twice, and saw a cat's prints and one lit window in Crosby Place. You tried a line aloud. It sounded grand through the stopped nose. You laughed, and you came back in. The Rose is not on today's bill in your hand. You did not go out to the play.
one_sentence: You stayed in while Titus played, and at night you laughed at a line through a stopped nose.
title: Stayed in and laughed at a line
